args.message:
Fix money rounding to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The round_money() docstring already stated banker's rounding
(ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail in the nightly
build. Switch the quantize() call to ROUND_HALF_EVEN so halves round
to the nearest even cent (e.g., 2.675 -> 2.68, 2.665 -> 2.66).

args.head: fix/money-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix money rounding to ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was actually using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Change

- Switched `round_money()` in `src/money.py` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, so half-cent values round to the nearest even cent (e.g., `2.675 -> 2.68`, `2.665 -> 2.66`).

## Testing

- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.

Fixes the failing nightly build. cc @alex
